format: single Mosquito Joe franchise business (territory of 25,000 to 35,000 Targeted Households, home-based)

invest.quote: The approximate total investment necessary to begin operation of a single Mosquito Joe® franchise business ranges from $150,155 to $191,575. This includes $82,446 to $83,096 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliate(s).

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee you must pay to us is $42,500, for a Territory containing at least 25,000 to 35,000 Targeted Households.
fee.note: $1.00 per Targeted Household above 35,000. Discounts (not combinable): VetFran $6,500; licensed pesticide applicator $2,500; Community Heroes up to 10%; Additional Concept 10%; HIRE 10-25%; roll-in 10-50%. In 2025 the average fee paid was approximately $33,920 (range $31,875 to $43,708). Development Agreement: 2 territories $85,000 total ($42,500 each) down to 5 territories $187,500 ($37,500 each).

royalty.basis: Gross Sales (10% on the first $500,000 per calendar year per Territory, 7% above $500,000)
royalty.quote: License Fee 10% of Gross Sales for Gross Sales of up to $500,000 (in a calendar year, per Territory); 7% of Gross Sales for Gross Sales above $500,000 (in the same calendar year, in the one Territory). In addition, minimum license fees apply.

adFund.quote: MAP Fee 2% of Gross Sales. Payable weekly, currently on Wednesdays.
adFund.note: Plus Local Marketing Groups 2% of Gross Sales, plus the mandatory Direct Marketing Program ($37,000 per year), plus a Local Performance Marketing Investment of $35,000 in the first 12 months.

otherRecurring.name: Direct Marketing Program Annual Program Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently: $37,000 per year Annual Program Fee (reduced to $26,000 the following year if Gross Sales reach $450,000, with $6,000 digital spend; 15% of Gross Sales if under $250,000, with the difference to $37,000 spent locally)

otherRecurring.name: Software System Monthly Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $474.45 per month plus $25 for each additional Territory after your first Territory

otherRecurring.name: Weekly Minimum License Fees (June-September only, from year 3)
otherRecurring.amount: Year 3 $325, Year 4 $400, Year 5 - End of Term $500 per week, June-September

otherRecurring.name: Annual Convention Fee
otherRecurring.amount: currently up to $1,000, plus travel and lodging; $2,000 pro-rata if you fail to attend

otherRecurring.name: Key Accounts/Management Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to 5% of total Gross Sales related to Key Account work

transferFee.amount: $7,500, if the gross sales price of the Business is less than $400,000; or $20,000 if the gross sales price of the Business is $400,000 or more. Development Agreement: $20,000

item19.note: Sales only, no costs. Results split by age group only: 117 businesses in their first 5 years averaged $208,341 (median $164,899); 290 businesses 6+ years averaged $444,223 (median $288,923); 105 (36%) of the 290 at or above average. Excludes 9 businesses that closed in 2025 and 4 that did not report the full period. Franchisee-reported via the Software System.

special: Mandatory Direct Marketing Program bought only from the franchisor or its affiliate: $37,000 per year per territory (prepaid before opening for the first season), plus $35,000 Local Performance Marketing Investment in the first 12 months, plus $325/month SEO Program. These fixed marketing costs are large relative to average sales (e.g. $208,341 for businesses in their first 5 years). Royalty drops from 10% to 7% only above $500,000 of annual Gross Sales per territory. Seasonal business; weekly minimum royalty applies June-September from year 3.
issues: No Item 19 average for all franchised businesses; headline uses the 6+ years group (290 of 407), the first-5-years group is in 'other'. Item 19 says it covers 407 businesses yet also that 4 were excluded (117 + 290 = 407). Annual software and SEO amounts computed as monthly x 12.
